say:1:1331028001:1.text: You bet! I'm always the best dressed at the ball!
say:1:1331028001:1.source_cn: 那当然，因为往年的舞会，我的妆造都是最好的！
say:1:1331028001:1.male: You bet! I'm always the best dressed at the ball!
say:1:1331028001:1.female: You bet! I'm always the best dressed at the ball!

say:2:1331028002:1.text: It took me an entire year to design my look just to keep the honor.
say:2:1331028002:1.source_cn: 为了能够延续这份荣誉，我可是构思了整整一年。
say:2:1331028002:1.male: It took me an entire year to design my look just to keep the honor.
say:2:1331028002:1.female: It took me an entire year to design my look just to keep the honor.

say:3:1331028003:1.text: So, is there anything else I can help you? I need to focus on my makeup already.
say:3:1331028003:1.source_cn: 好了，如果没什么事的话请不要打扰我，我要专心修容了。
say:3:1331028003:1.male: So, is there anything else I can help you? I need to focus on my makeup already.
say:3:1331028003:1.female: So, is there anything else I can help you? I need to focus on my makeup already.
